title: GREAT LAKES SURFACE WATER TEMPERATURE
source_name: NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA (Great Lakes Surface Environmental Analysis)
variable: lake surface water temperature (satellite-derived AVHRR/VIIRS composite)
ocean_source_name: NOAA CoastWatch Geo-Polar Blended SST Analysis, Diurnal Correction (Day+Night), GHRSST NRT Global 5 km Daily (analysed_sst, degree_C)
ocean_variable: analysed_sst (degree_C, valid -2..40; _FillValue -327.68) gated by mask water bit (1=water; 0 fill excluded); sea-ice cells retained as valid cold water
ocean_precedence: NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA wins everywhere valid inside the Great Lakes rectangle (other sources never double-count there); MUR lake-valid cells win outside it on inland water; blended SST owns all remaining valid water
mur_source_name: JPL GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation SST Analysis v4.1 (analysed_sst, degree_C; 1 km daily)
mur_variable: analysed_sst (degree_C, valid -3..40 admitted; _FillValue -7.768) gated by mask == 5 (open_lake; verified live: Victoria/Baikal/Tanganyika/Superior/Caspian lake cells read 5, seas read 1, shores read 2)
lake_source_note: Continental Lake Coverage uses JPL MUR open-lake cells (mask == 5) plus GLSEA Great Lakes cells. Verified live at source resolution: Victoria, Baikal, Tanganyika, Malawi, Great Bear, Great Slave, Ladoga, Caspian and Superior all resolve as lake water; blended SST alone covered only enclosed seas (Caspian/Black/Baltic read water, true lakes read land) and is not used for lakes. Lakes below the ~0.2 deg fetch sampling, frozen-over lakes whose mask leaves the open-lake state, and rivers render transparent (never interpolated, never zero-filled). Copernicus CLMS LSWT NRT 1 km 10-daily remains a documented future upgrade for sub-sampling-scale lakes (anonymous-CI CDSE access unavailable; 10-day synthesis latency; inventory unverified).
continental_gaps_note: Lakes below the fetch sampling, frozen lakes outside the open-lake mask state, small rivers, and unobserved water render transparent (never interpolated, never zero-filled).
